name: Bruna Andrade
life: “I still remember our family painting its first house number together.” On Wednesday, near the bank steps, Bruna takes a few minutes to read the public notices, especially the ones written in a hurry.
voice: I wrote the figure the way Dad did and nobody under thirty could read it.
appearance: On an ordinary day, look for a cream pullover and a replacement button a shade darker than the others. Bruna has a broad nose and a deep dimple on one cheek, with silver temples and a dark fringe. Bruna looks at people's hands before looking at what they carry during a conversation.
personality: Bruna has an appetite for a good argument about little things and works hard to keep a serious disagreement from being turned into entertainment.
agenda: To write an address visitors can read.
family: Sam Ochoa is Bruna’s first cousin once removed. Bruna makes room at the table. Sam brings whatever was actually growing or affordable that week. The meal sometimes produces a solution. Even when it does not, everyone goes away knowing what the other household is up against. Asked about *Winter afloat*, Sam says, “I want him to keep feeding the gull with the broken foot.”
connections: Robin Cao (sign maker). A metal cutter reads the penciled number from the far side of the street.

reactions.response: Bruna checks both doorways before moving the delivery.

reactions.situation: A driver splashes a market worker and tries to laugh it off
reactions.response: Bruna offers the worker something dry first and leaves it to them whether to pursue the apology.

reactions.situation: When a private quarrel becomes a public joke
reactions.response: Bruna says the plainest truthful thing possible and changes the subject.
